gholam.text:
رفقا خبر رسیده که آنتروپیک مدل جدیدش یعنی Claude Fable 5.2 رو معرفی کرده و طبق ادعایی که مطرح شده، یکی از مهندسان این شرکت از مدل خواسته تا از یه پوشه کاملاً خالی، یک سیستم‌عامل بسازه. اون‌طور که نقل شده، این مدل با به‌کارگیری بیش از ۱۰۰۰ زیرعامل هوشمند در طول هشت روز کار شبانه‌روزی، تونسته یک پیش‌نمایش اولیه و قابل‌بوت روی لپ‌تاپ تولید کنه که کرنل اختصاصی، درایورها، رابط پنجره‌ای و صفحه لاگین داره.

شرکت اعلام کرده این مدل و نسخه Mythos 5.2 در زمینه کدنویسی و استدلال قوی‌تر و تا ۳۰ درصد سریع‌تر شدن، و بنچمارک ولز (Vals) هم صدرنشینی اون رو تأیید کرده؛ البته در واکنش‌ها، بعضی کاربرا هم توصیه کردن اسیر فضای تبلیغاتی نشیم، چون به ادعای اون‌ها در آزمون‌های مستقل تفاوت کارایی نسبت به نسخه‌های قبلی آن‌چنان چشمگیر نبوده است.

links.text:
This is insane: An Anthropic engineer asked Claude Fable 5.2 to build an operating system from an empty folder.

The model coordinated over 1,000 subagents that spent eight days writing, testing and reviewing code around the clock, according to Anthropic.

The result was a working prototype that boots on a laptop. It has its own kernel, drivers for the disk, keyboard and network, persistent file storage, windows, a login screen, an installer and built-in Claude functionality.

Fable 5.2 looks like the holy grail and it was worth the wait.

quote.text:
LETS GO: Anthropic just announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2. And its insane!

According to the company, both outperform Opus 5.5 in almost every capability it evaluated, including coding, reasoning and vision.

TL;DR:

- Up to 30% faster output than Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, with clearer communication.

- On FrontierCode 2.0, Fable 5.2 at High effort matched Opus 5.5 at Max effort for roughly half the cost per task. At Xhigh, it had the highest score among the released models Anthropic tested.

- 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalized the existing proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours, translating it into a form a computer can check. Opus 5.5 completed 26% in 18 hours with the same setup.

- Mythos 5.2 accurately modeled 28 of 34 tested capsids, the protein shells used to deliver gene therapies.

- Both models performed as well as or better than recent Claude models on most alignment measures and were tested by external evaluators before release.

Medium effort is the default in Claude apps and Claude Code.
